title: Findings refusal
description: The body of a coded refusal of Qory Apiary to a request about findings or to a verdict: Forager's link refusal, https://qory.dev/contracts/forager/v1/link-refusal.schema.json, with from apiary. error is one of four codes, and each code has one status. 400 invalid_request: a body outside findings-post.schema.json, or whose must_understand lists a pointer that Qory Apiary does not define, with names, the first member that fails, and message. 404 not_found: an unknown run, or a finding id that is not in the work item's findings. 409 base_changed: a base that differs from the base that Qory Apiary stored for the work item and the target. 409 open_blocking_findings: the answer to a verdict passed of a stage while the stage owns an open blocking finding, at POST /v1/runs/<id>/verdict. stage is that stage, findings has the ids of up to 50 of those findings, and message is required with this code. Send the verdict changes-requested for the stage in place of passed; a verdict changes-requested or escalate is not refused for this cause. Findings that are not blocking, that are not open, or that another stage owns do not count. The message of open_blocking_findings has two lines: "Send changes-requested in place of passed: <stage> has <count> open blocking findings." and "  The open blocking findings are <ids>." For a count of 1, the first line is "Send changes-requested in place of passed: <stage> has 1 open blocking finding." and the second line is "  The open blocking finding is <id>." <count> is the number of open blocking findings of the stage, and <ids> are the ids in findings, joined by a comma and a space. The other members are as the link refusal defines them. The checks that come before these, such as the signature of the request, are outside this document.

error.description: The code of the refusal: invalid_request (400), not_found (404), base_changed (409) or open_blocking_findings (409).

from.description: apiary: the gateway passes on the refusal of Qory Apiary.

stage.description: The stage whose verdict passed is refused. Present exactly when error is open_blocking_findings.

findings.description: The ids of up to 50 open blocking findings that the stage owns. Present exactly when error is open_blocking_findings.
